title: #literacies #smallpoems Eclipse critiques of digital shallows rather flip my fancy in Fuana and Fora. Life itself living in tidal pools of Carr's Shal
summary: #literacies #smallpoems Eclipse critiques of digital shallows rather flip my fancy in Fuana and Fora. Life itself living in tidal pools of Carr's Shallows than sit in systems and Locks. Deep canals of well controlled knowledge
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#literacies
#smallpoems
Eclipse
critiques of
digital shallows
rather flip
my fancy
in Fuana and
Fora.
Life itself living
in tidal pools
of Carr's Shallows
than sit
in systems and Locks.
Deep canals
of well controlled
knowledge
